summary: Nil-map panic in parseServerSignature on malformed VerificationData in github.com/altcha-org/altcha-lib-go
details:
In v1 of github.com/altcha-org/altcha-lib-go, parseServerSignature only initializes ServerSignatureVerificationData.Extra when url.ParseQuery returns a nil error. Because url.ParseQuery returns partial results alongside a non-nil error on malformed percent-escapes, a crafted VerificationData value triggers a nil-map write panic before signature verification is performed.

The v2 module (github.com/altcha-org/altcha-lib-go/v2) is not affected.
